summary: The accepted v2 B10 result requires target.qualification_digest to identify a passing qualification report. The same report includes B10 and hashes the B10 evidence, so using its own digest is circular. No separate passing report for this target and policy exists; using the fictional fixture or an invented digest would be false evidence.

implementation.b8_observation: Workspace 240 MiB plus /tmp 16 MiB; combined writable budget 256 MiB. The probe verified ENOSPC on the first byte beyond the combined budget. A timed-out container was killed by ID and its exited state recorded.
implementation.exception_evidence: Lifecycle subprocess stderr is redacted and stdout is bounded before evidence is written.

required_decision: Harness must define a non-circular bootstrap for the first qualification digest, or revise the accepted B10 contract to reference an independently established qualification identity. Until then B10 stays not-run and no target can pass qualification.
